responsibilities: Own analytics data products across internal business functions
Design and maintain reusable intermediate models, business-facing gold models, metrics, access controls, tests, documentation, and Lightdash agent guidance
Turn ideas into production data products by working with stakeholders to define requirements, validating the results, and publishing them
Reconcile concepts that differ across source systems, and publish mappings, unmatched records, assumptions, and quality checks so conflicts stay visible
Deliver changes through the full production process, including SQL, dbt tests, Lightdash metadata, access rules, content validation, and AI agent instructions
Diagnose incorrect or stale results across the data layers, and partner with data engineering when the cause sits below the serving layer
Review modeling changes, pair with teammates, and help maintain shared standards

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: You will turn prototypes and one-off analyses into trusted, production-grade models and metrics.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Tests, reconciliations, quality checks, access controls and validation dominate, with no speed phrases in the role text.
evidence.domain_risk: own the analytics data products that our internal teams rely on to make decisions
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: A legal-AI company, but the role serves internal GTM and finance decisions with no regulatory-reporting language, so it is moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: This role reports directly to the Director of Data and works closely with the rest of the data team
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A data team under a Director with dbt and Lightdash in production, still turning prototypes into products, is a mid-stage function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Deliver changes through the full production process, including SQL, dbt tests, Lightdash metadata, access rules, content validation, and AI agent instructions
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Bullets name gold models, Lightdash metadata, dbt tests and agent instructions in context, so a reader knows the day-to-day work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: works closely with the rest of the data team and with internal partners such as GTM and Finance
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: GTM and finance partners get equal weight as the internal business functions served, so it is mixed.
evidence.autonomy_level: Own analytics data products across internal business functions
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role owns the analytics data products end to end and helps maintain standards.
evidence.ai_role: Design and maintain reusable intermediate models, business-facing gold models, metrics, access controls, tests, documentation, and Lightdash agent guidance
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate writes the guidance and instructions the Lightdash AI agents use, and also uses AI coding agents, so the tie-breaker gives ai_enabler.
evidence.testing_framing: Deliver changes through the full production process, including SQL, dbt tests
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Tests and quality checks are part of what the candidate designs and delivers.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: the guidance our Lightdash AI agents need to answer questions correctly
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trusted metrics, correct answers, visible conflicts and diagnosing incorrect results frame the role from its summary, so it is high.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Turn ideas into production data products
